reader.requirement: At --std 85 a numeric argument position must take an arithmetic expression (§1985:VI.6.2.1: numeric elementary identifiers, numeric literals, ZERO, operators, parentheses, unary sign, and numeric functions inside it), refuse anything else, and use its value including its operational sign.

edition-consulted.switches: sig.IntroducedIn > ctx.Edition.DialectLevel refuses a function not yet introduced (DiagnosticCatalog.IntrinsicFunctionNotYetIntroduced); the 1989 functions carry IntroducedIn 85 in IntrinsicCatalog, so --std 85 admits them
ArgPredicate.AppliesAt(ctx.Edition.Edition.Year) gates each per-position predicate by its Since year; the class screen itself (IntrinsicArgumentRules.Violation over Verified) is edition-blind
ConstructRegistry NumericFunctionIdentifierOperand2002: at --std 85 a numeric/integer function is admitted only inside an arithmetic expression (a nested function argument is one)

reader.edition-search: grep -n 'Edition|CobolVersion|since|Std|1985|1989' over IntrinsicArgumentRules.cs and IntrinsicBinder.cs; the only edition reads on the argument path are ArgPredicate.Since/AppliesAt, sig.IntroducedIn and the 2002 placement construct; ClassOf1/ClassOfPlace/ClassOfItem/ClassOfPic/Admissible/Violation consult no edition
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: no: the 'n'/'i' class screen and the evaluation are the same arm at 85 and 2023; later-edition operand forms (floating-point literal) are refused at 85 by the literal's own construct gate
reader.witnesses-cover: part: g85_f32_01 covers expressions over a DISPLAY item; scaled (P), SIGN SEPARATE, packed, binary, the 18-digit maximum, ALL subscripts over ODO and the refusal half are not exercised

probes.printed: MATCH: INTEGER(-2.5 SIGN LEADING SEPARATE)=-3, INTEGER-PART=-2, LOG(PIC 9PP 300)=5.703782, LOG10(PIC VPP9 .005)=-2.301030, LOG10(S9(18) all 9s)=18.000000, INTEGER(packed -100/3)=-34, LOG(-S2)=4.605170, LOG10(binary -7*-7+51)=2, MEAN(TE(ALL)) over ODO N=3 = -1, INTEGER(-0.5)=-1, LOG(LOG10(100000))=1.609438, LOG10(TE(N-1))=0.301030, LOG(ZERO+1)=0
probes.expected: each arithmetic-expression argument evaluated with its operational sign (A.2.2 AR1) and the function value from it

probes.printed: COBOL1627 on each: LOG(PIC X item), LOG("100"), LOG(PIC Z9.9 numeric-edited), LOG10(group), LOG10(PIC A item), LOG10(SPACE), INTEGER(PIC X item), LOG10(AN(1:2)); exit 65
probes.expected: refused: none is an arithmetic expression (§1985:VI.6.2.1: identifier of a numeric elementary item, numeric literal, ZERO)

probes.printed: MATCH: COMPUTE K = INTEGER(K - 3.5) with K=2 gives -2; COMPUTE K TE(K) ROUNDED = LOG10(K + 99) gives K=2, TE(2)=2.0000; INTEGER(- Z0)=0
probes.expected: argument evaluated once from the value before the store, sign kept; the receiver subscript evaluated at the store

probes.printed: COBOL0900 national literal N"abc" requires COBOL-2002; COBOL0900 floating-point literal 1.5E2 requires COBOL-2002; exit 65
probes.expected: a later edition's operand forms (national literal, floating-point literal) are not 1985 literals and are refused

reader.notes: Classifier: BoundComputedOperand/BoundNumericLiteral/numeric BoundFieldOperand answer class numeric; Admissible('n') is ClassNumeric (numeric-edited excluded, matching §1985:VI.6.2.1's 'numeric elementary item'). refuter.evidence: Read §1989:A.2.2 (numeric = an arithmetic expression) and §1985:VI.6.2.1 (identifier of a numeric elementary item, numeric literal, figurative ZERO). Probes at --std 85 (runs under E:/COBOL-coord/scratch/coderead-1985/out/refute-1985-168/runs): nref2-001 refuses LOG10(ALL "5"), LOG10(HIGH-VALUE), LOG10(QUOTE), LOG(LOW-VALUE), LOG10(FUNCTION REVERSE ("1")), LOG(FUNCTION CHAR (50)) with COBOL1627, LOG(IX) index-name with COBOL1637, LOG(IXD) USAGE INDEX with COBOL6979 citing §1985:VI.5.14.3 SR5; npos2-001 admits and evaluates LOG10(+100)=2, LOG10(10 ** 2)=2, LOG10(- (- 1000))=3, LOG10(ZEROES + 10)=1, LOG10(FUNCTION INTEGER (100.7))=2, LOG10(- S1 * 10) with S1 SIGN TRAILING SEPARATE -10.0 =2, LOG(FUNCTION LENGTH ("ABCDEFG") + 0)=1.945910, LOG10(1 / 4 + 0.75)=0, LOG10(.001)=-3; aref2-001 refuses hex literal X"41" at 85 (COBOL0900). cite.py: OK §1985:VI.6.2.1 the text is in the clause; OK §1985:VI.5.14.3 SR5 the text is in SR5; OK §1985:IV.4.3.8.3.3 SR1 the text is in SR1.
